dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect used in Japanese medical billing system. Program ID ORCSC60200804 follows ORCA naming convention.

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (診療行為入力 - medical procedure input/check/calculation). Handles inpatient/outpatient procedure checking, point calculation, duplicate checks, and H20.4 revision compliance.
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software system. It performs medical procedure act checking and calculation (診療行為チェック・算定), including inpatient/outpatient fee calculation, duplicate procedure checks, examination group management, and compliance with Japanese medical insurance fee schedule revisions (H18.4, H20.4).

notable_features: 15 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
252 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Extensive Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
Large inline lookup table (TBL-KENSA-HOU-AREA) with medical procedure codes
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
OCCURS tables for medical procedure grouping and inpatient day tracking
Revision history spanning 2000-2008 with multiple contributors (MCC, NACL)
verdict.notes: Japanese text in comments is EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. File is 4566 lines, truncated at 16000 chars for analysis. The program is clearly production medical billing software from the well-known JMA ORCA open-source project. No COMP-3 is unusual but consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase style.
